lede: South Carolina carries the stronger underlying team rating — +4.6 against +2.9, a 1.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it South Carolina -2.8 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with South Carolina winning 58% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 88% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
